Overview

Lucerne is a city in Lucerne with a population of 82,000. A picture-perfect city on Lake Lucerne surrounded by snow-capped Alps, famous for its Chapel Bridge, Lion Monument, and the annual Lucerne Festival. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
